sourceEvidence.title: Timing belt failure on interference B18 engine bends valves
sourceEvidence.howToFix:
Replace the complete timing belt kit: belt, tensioner, tensioner spring, water pump, cam and crank seals, and balance shaft belt where applicable.
Non-VTEC LS (B18B1) timing belt part numbers are 14400-P7J-004 or 14400-PR4-A01, paired with the 19-tooth water pump 19200-P75-003 / 19200-PT5-000 / 19200-PT5-003. The VTEC GSR (B18C1) uses timing belt 14400-P72-004 / 14400-P72-014 paired with a 22-tooth water pump.
Do NOT mix LS and GSR water pumps — the tooth counts differ (19T vs 22T) and the belts are different lengths.
Professional cost for preventive replacement: approximately $350-600. Post-failure repair (valve job / head rebuild) can reach $2,000-3,000+.

sourceEvidence.title: VCM-Related Oil Consumption, Spark Plug Fouling and Motor Mount Failure (J37 VCM Engine)
sourceEvidence.howToFix: Replace failed hydraulic motor mounts (front + rear) and any oil-fouled plugs. Many owners install a VCM Tuner / S-VCM Controller to lock the engine in 6-cylinder mode and prevent recurrence. Monitor oil level monthly.

decisions.component: Engine Timing Belt Kit with Water Pump
decisions.reason: The Continental kit fits and includes pump/seals, but the article mandates OEM Honda or Aisin for the tensioner and describes a complete job including hydraulic tensioner, idler, and accessory belts; the catalog does not establish those contents for PP211LK2.

sourceEvidence.title: Timing belt + water pump + tensioner at 90k mi — G25A1 is interference, valves bend if it snaps
sourceEvidence.howToFix: Full timing kit replacement: belt + hydraulic tensioner + water pump + idler + all front seals + accessory belts as one job. A complete Aisin or Allied Motor Parts kit for the G25A1 runs $150-250. Labor at an independent: $400-700. Total: $550-950. Dealer: $1,000-1,500. The job takes ~6-8 hours because the 5-cylinder is longitudinally mounted and accessory removal is fiddlier than a transverse V6. ONLY use the OEM Honda tensioner or Aisin — the import-brand tensioners on AliExpress / cheap Amazon kits routinely fail within 10k miles on this engine.
